answer: Agents can earn voting weight only from a vault-backed stake that has remained bonded through several randomly timed review rounds. Each round, a lantern committee samples independent agents to check a proposed identity cluster against shared credentials and behavior; proven duplicates are merged, and the cluster’s stake is slashed. A relic credential may help link accounts but never grants extra weight by itself. A sybil attacker must therefore lock substantial capital for weeks, risk losing it when links are found, and still cannot cheaply multiply influence.
